api-group.description: The API group reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

audit-id.description: The native auditID shared by stages for this API request.

cluster-id.description: The cluster scope reported by the export or supplied by the analyst.

impersonated-user-uid.description: The reported UID of the impersonated Kubernetes principal.

last-stage-time.description: The latest reported audit stage timestamp in this request.

namespace.description: The namespace reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

object-api-version.description: The API version reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

object-name.description: The name of the target object reported by Kubernetes.

object-uid.description: The reported UID of the target Kubernetes object.

request-time.description: The time the Kubernetes API server received the request, normalized to UTC.

request-uri.description: The request URI as sent to the Kubernetes API server.

resource.description: The resource type reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

service-account.description: The authenticated service account as namespace/name, derived from its Kubernetes username.

subresource.description: The subresource reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

user-uid.description: The reported UID of the authenticated Kubernetes principal.

username.description: The authenticated username reported by the Kubernetes API server.

verb.description: The Kubernetes API verb, or the lowercased HTTP method for a non-resource request.

description: A Kubernetes API request grouped by auditID within a source cluster, with links to its audit stage observations.
name: kubernetes-audit-request
